query: Why do some Amazon products receive predominantly negative reviews, and which factors contribute the most?

per_column.name: product_quality_failure
per_column.rationale: Categorizes a concrete failure axis (performance, build, durability) directly relevant to identifying drivers of negative reviews. Values in samples are correctly 'not_present' for reviews about dolls, books, music, and cosmetics where no quality failure is described; groundedness supported.

per_column.name: performance_misalignment
per_column.rationale: Captures whether the product underperforms claims - a distinct, useful factor. Some conceptual overlap with product_quality_failure's 'performance_issue', but it targets claims-vs-reality specifically. Samples correctly marked 'not_present'.

per_column.name: design_flaw_type
per_column.rationale: Distinct axis (ergonomics, safety, operation difficulty) that gives real grouping leverage for physical products. Sample values plausibly 'not_present' for non-physical items. Well grounded.

per_column.name: customer_experience_failure
per_column.rationale: Useful high-level bucket, but its values look questionable: reviews about the absence of a black doll, a disappointing book, and a diss track are all labeled 'value_mismatch', which is a strained reading. These are content/preference complaints, not value/price mismatches, suggesting over-eager categorization not well grounded in the text.

per_column.name: value_mismatch_type
per_column.rationale: Adds a specific price/value sub-dimension (durability-for-cost, false advertising) useful for the query. Correctly 'not_present' across all samples where price is not discussed; conservative and grounded.

per_column.name: reviewer_emotional_intensity
per_column.rationale: A generic intensity score close to a bare sentiment-strength flag, giving limited analytical leverage for identifying WHICH factors drive negativity. Values also look inconsistent/inflated: a glowing positive skincare review ('can't get enough of it') and a positive film review both scored 4, contradicting the text's tone, undermining groundedness.

judge.rationale: Most added columns provide genuine, distinct axes (quality failure, performance vs claims, design flaws, value mismatch) that directly support diagnosing drivers of negative reviews, with conservative and mostly well-grounded 'not_present' handling. Weaknesses: customer_experience_failure applies 'value_mismatch' too loosely to preference/content complaints, and reviewer_emotional_intensity is both generically low-leverage and mis-scores clearly positive reviews as high intensity, indicating some ungrounded values.
